facts.fact: Morocco's Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform announced the launch of a new version of the national Idarati portal, centred on Idarati e-Services as a unified access point to administrations' digital services.
The ministry says the Idarati portal gives access to 874 online services, organised around priority user journeys, and 2,533 published administrative acts.
